const fn: any = function named() { };
Object.defineProperty(fn, 'fixed', { value: 1 });
Object.defineProperty(fn, 'accessor', { get() { return 2; } });
Object.preventExtensions(fn);
const actions = [() => Object.setPrototypeOf(fn, {}), class {
  static remove() { delete fn.fixed; }
}.remove, class {
  static assign() { fn.fixed = 2; }
}.assign, class {
  static write() { fn.accessor = 3; }
}.write];
console.log('before');
for (const action of actions) {
  try { action(); }
  catch (error) { if (error instanceof Error) console.log(error.name, error.message); }
}
console.log(fn.fixed, fn.accessor);
